usageNotes: Use this to list all backup snapshots in a specific datastore on a PBS remote, optionally scoped to a namespace. Requires the remote to be reachable from PDM and the caller to hold Resource.Audit on the target remote/datastore path. Each result includes backup-type (vm/ct/host), backup-time (Unix epoch), the constituent archive files, protection status, and any last verification result — making this the primary read for auditing backup coverage or checking whether a snapshot was verified.

examples.summary: List all snapshots in the 'main' datastore on the 'hetzner-pbs' remote, scoped to the 'clients/acme' namespace

tips: Omit the 'ns' query param to list snapshots from the datastore root namespace; nested namespaces are not returned unless explicitly targeted.
backup-time is a Unix epoch integer — convert to a human-readable date before displaying to users.
The 'fingerprint' field is present only for encrypted backups; its absence means the snapshot is unencrypted.
A snapshot with 'protected: true' will be skipped by prune jobs — check this field before assuming a snapshot is eligible for cleanup.
The verification.state field reflects the most recent verify task outcome ('ok' or 'failed'); a missing verification object means no verify has ever been run on that snapshot.
